0x000788.en: 「Th-this is as far as I go...!」

0x0007BA.en: 「With what I've got now...@　this is my limit...!」

0x0008B3.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x00092D.en: 「Is this... where it all ends, hm...?」

0x0009DC.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...!?」

0x000B18.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　Not funny...」

0x000B6C.en: 「I blew it...!@　No choice but to bail...」

0x000C56.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000CBD.en: 「This is it... the rest is on you.」

0x000D2B.en: 「Ngh! Looks like they got the jump on me...」

0x000D69.en: 「No good, took too many hits... Retreating!」

0x000DB6.en: 「I'm beaten. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000DF4.en: 「Kyah! The rest is up to you!」

0x000E3B.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000EE6.en: 「Ngh... So I've become a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x00108F.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0010D6.en: 「I'm sorry, the rest is up to you.」

0x00110B.en: 「Damn it! Is this all my power can do...!」

0x0011C8.en: 「Ngh... You're good, I'll give you that.」

0x0011F7.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@　I'm still too green...!」

0x001245.en: 「No, this is as far as I go! Falling back!」

0x00132F.en: 「No good! This is the end of the line!!」

0x00136D.en: 「Well, well. So this is as far as it goes.」

0x00139C.en: 「I can't take any more. If you'll excuse me.」

0x001427.en: 「Careless of me...@　I'll pull back for now...!」

0x00164B.en: 「Guuh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x00188F.en: 「Guess I've got no choice but to fall back...!」

0x0018DF.en: 「So, Yang Long... where are we headed now?」

0x00191F.en: 「Dunk City.@　We got word a Shutedonias unit is there,@　so we're going to scout it out.」

0x0019C8.en: 「No. First I want to get close and check@　Dunk City's situation and the enemy's strength.@　Whether we strike comes after that.」

0x001A73.en: 「Watching from up on the mountain again?@　We should just charge in and clean house.」

0x001AE7.en: 「...You're just like Masaki.@　That kind of thinking will get you tripped up by the enemy.」

0x001B4F.en: 「Dragging things out just isn't my style.」

0x001B8C.en: 「But this time, you do it my way.@　We're heading to Dunk City.」

0x001C1C.en: 「...Ranshao and I will go scout Dunk City.@　The rest of you wait here.」

0x001C9C.en: 「Hold on! Something's coming from the town!」

0x001D04.en: 「Gespensts too!@　Could that be Lieutenant Katina's group!?」

0x001D5D.en: 「Looks like they're being chased by someone.」

0x001D8E.en: 「Yang Long, those three are our comrades!@　We're going to help them!」

0x001E13.en: 「The size of the enemy force stationed in@　Dunk City still isn't clear.@　Charging in blindly is too dangerous.」

0x001EA6.en: 「Are you telling me to abandon our friends!?」

0x001EFF.en: 「It's no use stopping me! Let's go, Kyosuke!」

0x001FC2.en: 「There's a transmission for you, Master.@　Please return to the Granveil.」

0x00202D.en: 「At a time like this...? Who is it?」

0x00208F.en: 「Tch, that bearded samurai!@　So this was his plan all along!」

0x0020FB.en: 「Hmph... Crossing blades with you lot@　is more fun than fighting alongside you.」

0x002160.en: 「If I'd known you were with them from the start,@　I never would've taken the deal!」

0x0021CE.en: 「I'm sick of just running!@　Boys, we're turning to fight!」

0x002290.en: 「A-Alt's here too!@　Wait, does that mean Lieutenant Kyosuke@　got warped to this world too!?」

0x002333.en: 「Well now, the Alteisen Riese@　and the Valsione.」

0x002383.en: 「That Guarlion...@　Right, a merc hired by the <Neue DC> remnants.」

0x0023ED.en: 「Running into you here... we go way back.」

0x00242A.en: 「If even they're here...@　Hmph, staying in this other world a while longer might be amusing.」

0x00249B.en: 「Yang Long! What are you doing here!?」

0x0024CF.en: 「I came to help you. And I brought backup.」

0x002522.en: 「Gennacy I. Kozireh. This is the@　<Masou Kishin> Jaohm. Good to meet you.」

0x0025CF.en: 「Come now, still sore about earlier?@　I never opposed helping them at all.」

0x00265E.en: 「Know your enemy, know yourself, and you'll@ never lose... I just warned against the folly@ of fighting blind, with no intel on the foe.」

0x002706.en: 「Fine, fine, I get it!@　If you want to lecture me, I'll hear plenty of it later!」

0x00276E.en: 「...My employer's fled, has he.@　Then I'll leave this bout unsettled for now.」

0x0027C7.en: 「...All right, pursuers dealt with?@　My thanks, Kyosuke, Lune.」

0x00282F.en: 「Good timing on our part.@　But why were you being chased by them?」

0x002891.en: 「We've got plenty to ask you too.@　Let's trade information.」

0x0028FD.en: 「...If you were summoned mid-exercise,@　then it's safe to assume the Hiryu Kai and@　Hagane got dragged over here too...」

0x00298D.en: 「Me, Lieutenant Katina, and Russel@　all came out in the same spot, but Leona and@　the others seem to've been scattered elsewhere...」

0x002A38.en: 「And while we were searching for them,@　we ran into that bunch of goofballs' army.」

0x002AD1.en: 「Right, that's the one.@　They said they'd take us into protective custody@　and asked for our cooperation, but...」

0x002B5E.en: 「That samurai Guarlion was with them.@　Figured they were shady and turned them@　down, and they jumped us out of nowhere.」

0x002C03.en: 「If you won't join us, you're the enemy...@　Figured they'd take you out early, did they.」

0x002C68.en: 「Either way, glad we ran into you.@　And it's good to know Kyosuke's safe too.」

0x002CDF.en: 「Big sis Excellen and the others were real worried, y'know.」

0x002D3E.en: 「Um... we still don't really understand@　much about La Gias. If you don't mind,@　could you explain it in more detail?」

0x002DEC.en: 「Understood.@　There's an inn in Dunk City. We'll rest there@　and talk over what to do next.」

0x002E9B.en: 「Y-you were there? ...Man,@　you barely have any presence.」

0x002EE9.en: (Somehow I feel a sense of kinship with him...)
